mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the uprights with the crossbar was the clearest structural payoff: the separate posts became a recognizable rectangular frame.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips were less distinct in text, since the descriptions of the sides changed only subtly.

surprise.text: The completed window showed a pinwheel entering, tilting and leaving; I had not expected that motion from connecting the lead.

arbitrary.text: The lead’s destination and the struts’ supporting role were not clear from the descriptions, although the goals told me what to fit.

continue.text: I would probably continue briefly to see what the window and pinwheel do together, although the largely prescribed fittings offered few meaningful decisions.
